question: How does Pārvatī ask Śiva to prevent others from obtaining this teaching?
premises: Another person might obtain the teaching.
Pārvatī asks that this not happen.
She requests Śiva to act accordingly.
inference: Pārvatī asks Śiva to arrange matters so others do not obtain the teaching.
plain_english: So that another may not obtain it in that way, act accordingly, O sweet-speaking one.
